'Twas such a night as this: There was not a breath of air to auffle the smooth surface of the calm Adriatic; aught was he dead same the distant twinkling of the solitary Sheep bell, & the low backing of the hornet watchdog. He stood beside a tomb - a deep high rent his boomer & even anon as he cut his teafuel, languid eye to the pale, sharte moon, & of heaven, he exclaimeth: Oh, so! What a night - for calling Coons!
